changes: New: DROPOUT, random dropouts on FX1 or FX2, like a worn tape or a failing stream.
CHNC sets how often they come, LEN how long they last, EDGE how hard they cut; between them the track is untouched.
MODE drops to silence (GAP), a stuck loop (HOLD) or a crushed copy (CRSH); TONE darkens the dropout.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta). Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
